fallback_model.fallback_rationale_summary: Same 384-d storage; explicit query/passage prefixes; MIT; useful if BGE tooling or similarity calibration differs on ProductIQ pilot in Phase 4.11.

limitations: English-only models; AJIO catalog text is predominantly English but brand tokens may include non-ASCII.
Model selection used published benchmarks and ProductIQ engineering criteria; no full-catalog embedding pilot was required to freeze the contract.
Phase 4.8 lexical benchmark (10 queries) is not sufficient alone to rank embedding models; reuse for Phase 4.14 semantic evaluation only.
phase_4_11_dependencies_note: Embedding generation libraries (e.g. sentence-transformers, FlagEmbedding) are intentionally not pinned in Phase 4.10; pin versions when implementing the generation pipeline.

query_encoding.instruction_prefix: Represent this sentence for searching relevant passages:
query_encoding.notes: Passages/documents use semantic_text without instruction (short query → long passage retrieval).

primary_model.selection_rationale_summary: English retrieval-tuned small model; 384-dim pgvector-friendly footprint; strong MTEB retrieval vs MiniLM-class baselines; fits labeled AJIO semantic_text lengths; local CPU/GPU batch inference feasible at 367k scale.

productiq_context.phase_4_9_alignment: L2-normalized embeddings compared via cosine similarity (SemanticVector / cosine_similarity)

storage_raw_float32_bytes_per_product.notes: PostgreSQL/pgvector row and index overhead will exceed raw float32 payload; HNSW/IVFFlat indexes add substantial disk.
